data.name: Altaam
data.long_meaning: Originated from the Arabic root letters 'A-L-T', Altaam refers to a person who is brave, valiant, and steadfast in the face of adversity. This name is mentioned in the Quran, where Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) is described as Al-Mut'im Al-'Azeem, a title of respect that means 'the possessor of a great and steadfast soul'.
